title: How a privileged token function drained the 79AU pool
dek: A privileged token function enabled nine pulls from the pool to three recipients, despite protections against LP-based withdrawals.
asOf: Report snapshot: October 9, 2026. All times are UTC.
author: ChainBounty Research

blocks.title: The permission behind the drain
paragraphs: On October 7, 2026, a privileged token function moved 79AU out of a PancakeSwap pool without payment. Recipients could sell tokens back for USDT. Burned LP receipts did not remove this token-level authority.
The figures below summarize the published account. Token quantities, transfer amounts, and later wallet balances are shown separately.

blocks.title: Nine pulls, three recipients

rows.label: Third wallet
rows.detail: One pull of 10,000 79AU. Purpose unexplained; the published account does not supply a complete address.

blocks.title: The token permission remained the issue
paragraphs: The published account records no recovery at its October 9 snapshot. It leaves key theft versus insider misuse unresolved; destination-chain payouts remain outside its scope.
takeaways: Follow the identified holdings and custodial lead.
Revoke residual pull permissions or migrate the contract.
A negotiation is not evidence of returned assets.
